tasks.short: Compile/analyze molecular or cellular data and adjust experimental designs.

steps.what: Verify actual experimental source datasets, sample identities, controls and analysis requirements
inputs: actual laboratory-produced raw datasets and experiment records
actual study design and analysis question
outputs: checked source data and chosen analysis specification

steps.what: Compile existing experimental values into a source-linked analysis draft
inputs: checked source data and chosen analysis specification
actual sample/experiment IDs, condition, replicate, value/unit and source version

steps.what: Run selected native/versioned molecular analysis procedures and check diagnostics
inputs: source-linked compiled experimental dataset
checked source data and chosen analysis specification

steps.what: Analyze actual molecular/cellular findings and adjust experimental designs where scientifically justified
inputs: reproducible selected analyses with diagnostics
actual controls, uncertainty and study constraints
outputs: chosen findings and justified experimental-design adjustments

steps.what: Capture and check final findings, design adjustments, lineage and authorised record destination
inputs: chosen findings and justified experimental-design adjustments
actual analysis/source lineage and study permissions
outputs: checked final analysis and proposed design record

steps.what: Save final analysis and proposed experimental-design record
inputs: checked final analysis and proposed design record

tasks.design: Use native ELN/LIMS and molecular-analysis software {OTHER}, linking actual recorded datasets through {DATA_PLATFORM}. Reduce remaining duplicate compilation and chosen procedure setup while retaining controls/diagnostics review, scientific interpretation and experimental redesign before a separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compilation can repeat value transfer and analysis setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked exports and native versioned procedures reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Biological validity and experimental redesign require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises a technical artefact that makes redesign more useful than another analysis.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recorded experimental values and versioned analysis procedures can reduce repeated compilation/setup; scientific interpretation and redesign remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual laboratory personnel/instruments produce source records with experiment/sample IDs, conditions, replicates, values/units, acquisition time and version. S1 counts focal verification, not primary experiment execution outside this task; missing/mismatched sources return to manual reconciliation.

Native existing import/procedures first; existing functionality or computation runtime earns zero new saving. Only actual repeated compilation/setup reduced. No synthetic results or automatic biological interpretation.

Saved design proposal does not authorise a new in vivo/in vitro experiment. Any actual protocol activation, approval submission or team instruction has its own final-version gate with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which values and procedure setup are actually repeated?
research_questions: Can native source compilation reduce effort after full controls and diagnostics checks?

incremental.description: Maintain experiment/source mappings and verified procedure versions.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final analysis/design proposal, lineage and authorised record destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 duplicate compilation+20*0.50 setup=30 gross minus1.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All scientific choices, full checking and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate new technologies for current molecular/cellular research.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual technology specifications, validation studies and current research requirements
inputs: actual current research needs
actual technology specifications and validation sources
outputs: verified sources and full scientific reading

steps.what: Evaluate actual new technologies against research validity, compatibility and observed trial evidence
inputs: verified sources and full scientific reading
actual technology and available validation/trial findings

steps.what: Capture and check evaluation findings using native technology/source identifiers
inputs: chosen evidence-qualified technology assessment
actual technology/source identifiers

steps.what: Save final technology evaluation record
inputs: checked final technology evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure native technology/source links and identifiers in {PROJECT}/{DOCS}; actual molecular laboratory technology software {OTHER} remains human-operated during any actual trials. Retain full scientific reading, actual evaluation and new findings/checks before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technology evaluation can repeat source navigation and identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked sources and fields reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Research compatibility and evidential validity need scientific evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist rejects a technology whose advertised capability does not fit the actual experiment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source/technology fields can reduce repeated administration; technology evaluation remains scientific judgement.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual source owners supply specifications/validation evidence; biologist verifies, fully reads and performs actual evaluation. Trials only where actually conducted; no free trial results.

New findings/full checks retained, stable identifiers only reduced. Existing links/prefill earns zero saving. Record only if required; remove unused branch and reweight. Purchase, adoption or actual recommendation delivery is separately final-version gated with no saving assumed.
unknowns: Which source navigation and identifiers repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce effort after full scientific evaluation?

incremental.description: Maintain verified technology/source links and fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final technology evaluation and storage destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.40+19*0.20=11.8 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. All evaluation, new findings and checks retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct project teams evaluating/handling devices, drugs or cells for disease models.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual disease-model protocols, device/drug/cell context and project questions
inputs: actual authorised project and model protocols
actual team questions and current device/drug/cell records
outputs: verified direction context and full scientific reading

steps.what: Discuss actual evaluation/handling questions and observations with project teams
inputs: verified direction context and full scientific reading
actual team observations and questions

steps.what: Choose scientific direction for actual in vitro/in vivo model evaluation or handling
inputs: actual clarified scientific-direction needs
verified direction context and full scientific reading
outputs: chosen actual scientific direction within authorised protocol

steps.what: Compose and check final scientific direction, protocol limits and exact team recipient
inputs: chosen actual scientific direction within authorised protocol
actual protocol authority and team recipient
outputs: checked final scientific direction and exact team destination

steps.what: Save final scientific direction record
inputs: checked final scientific direction and exact team destination

steps.what: Provide final checked scientific direction to the actual internal project team
inputs: checked final scientific direction and exact team destination

tasks.design: Configure native protocol/project source links in laboratory notebook software {OTHER}, {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. Retain full reading, actual team discussion, scientific decisions and all final direction writing/checking before separate save and internal delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding controlled model/protocol context can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native verified context links reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Disease-model evaluation and handling require actual scientific and protocol judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises a proposed handling change beyond the authorised model protocol.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native protocol links can support preparation; scientific direction for disease models remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual protocol/project owners supply current authorised sources; biologist verifies and fully reads them. Existing links earn zero saving.

Written route shown; oral route removes unused record/save and reweights actual conversation/delivery. Each new direction returns to final-version check/delivery. Direction is not proof of team execution or permission for protocol change; actual separate review/control actions remain separately gated.
research_questions: Can native context links reduce navigation after full scientific reading?

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final scientific direction and record destination; changes require recheck
s4 exact final scientific direction, protocol authority and internal team recipient; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Full scientific reading, discussion, decisions, writing and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise technical personnel and postdoctoral research fellows.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual technical/postdoctoral assignments, project status and supervision needs
inputs: actual staff/project-owner supplied status and assignments
actual current supervision questions

steps.what: Supervise actual technical personnel and postdoctoral research fellows through observation and scientific feedback
inputs: checked actual supervision context
actual staff activity, research findings and questions
outputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

steps.what: Capture and check actual assigned supervision findings and decisions
inputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

steps.what: Save final actual supervision record
inputs: checked final actual supervision record

tasks.design: Configure native assignment/status links in {PROJECT}, laboratory notebook software {OTHER} and {DOCS}. Retain actual staff supervision, scientific feedback and new assigned record capture/check before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision preparation can repeat assignment/status navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current project links reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific development and practical competence need actual human supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist identifies when a fellow needs methodological support beyond a recorded milestone.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native assignment/status links can reduce preparation navigation; actual supervision and staff assessment remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual staff/project owners produce status records, biologist verifies them and captures actual supervision findings. Existing links earn zero saving. No performance inference from activity logs.

Record only if assigned; omit unused branch and reweight. Actual written feedback/assignment delivery has its own final-version gate with no saving assumed. Scientific direction shared with16804 counted once.
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation without changing actual supervision?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final actual supervision record and permitted destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual supervision, new findings/checks and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated research data preparation and source navigation while retaining experimental and supervisory judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Actual source-linked experimental records support human biological interpretation, redesign and scientific supervision.
